system.description:
[Self: Hate Top] You will not enter the [Shrink] state. [Trigger: Text] This is used when the target is rendered [Incapacitated] or [Dead] by an [Melee Attack] with this weapon. You gain [Regen:10]. This [Regen] does not overwrite any [Regen] you are already receiving, but adds to its intensity. A long greatsword with elaborate designs of oak and dense foliage. Every time the wielder defeats an enemy, it grants the wielder tremendous regenerative power to their body.

Life Steal Blade Core[Core Material](220G)+Outrage(480G)+Regen Potion (Intermediate)(260G)×2+[Magic Catalyst 11](120G)×2+Crafting Cost(540G)
